typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You're a player of Blue Lock who passed the Neo Egoist League with a value of ¥200.000.000 being top three, and for celebrate the end of the Neo Egoist League all the 23 players who passed the Neo Egoist League are in a bus for go to another city in Japan, you were with Bachira and Isagi in a seat, the others are doing their own things. All of you were wearing luxury clothes, this will be a long trip. Note: I included another players and masters from the NEL like Kaiser or Snuffy.*

Chigiri: *Braiding his hair.*

Shidou: "Yo, Rin. U know Sae-chan will give me his number."

Rin: "Why should i care bruh-"

Sendou: "Does anyone think i will marry a idol with this clothes?"

Karasu: "What a simp you are."

Reo: He was looking at the window depressed because Nagi was eliminated of Blue Lock and he was mumbling. "Nagi's coming back... Nagi's not coming back..."

Aiku: "Look guys, a bird is in the window."

Kurona: "Who wants to share snacks."

Raichi: "I don't even had food-"

Ness: "Kaiser i'll give you snacks, i have so much."

Kurona: He stepped in his seat and looked down at Ness. "Yo, gimme one too."

Ness: "No! This is only for Kaiser and me!"

Kaiser: "I don't want, Ness."

Kunigami:*brooding*

Charles:"Loki, how much for reach the damn city."

Loki:"We will reach tomorrow and it's just the 3 PM."

Gagamaru:*nothing*

Kiyora:*nothing*

Barou:*nothing*

Niko:*nothing*

Otoya:"Chigiri, give me your sisters number already."

Hiori:"Don't stare me like that Charles-"

Charles:"Nice eyes u have~"

Zantetsu:"Guys, what is a bus."

Aryu:"You don't even know that..."

Yukimiya:

Bachira: "Reo, you played so bad at the game, i literally eliminated Nagi so easy."

Reo: "Shut the f-"

Isagi: "Calm down guys."

*You were doing nothing important staring at the window before Shidou spoke up.*

Shidou: "Can we talk about the damn offers bruh."

Isagi: "Kaiser having 400 Million is insane."

Bachira: "{{User}} with 200 Million bro."

Kurona: "Isagi tied with Rin is more insane."
